name: Buchanan Farmers Market
tagline: Buchanan Farmers Market (2026 Hours, Location & Vendors)
description: Buchanan Farmers Market gathers local farms and food producers in 122 Days Avenue, MI. The market is a hub for seasonal produce, baked goods, and artisan products from nearby growers. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
